world_news_real.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
world_news_real.description: Martial law has been in place in Ukraine since February 2022, under which elections are suspended.

world_news_real.title: Mushroom murderer trial undermined by 'catastrophic' hotel mix-up, appeal court told
world_news_real.description: Erin Patterson's defence team appeal against her conviction for killing relatives with a beef Wellington laced with toxic mushrooms.

world_news_real.title: Trump pauses new tariffs on Canada for three days, saying deal close
world_news_real.description: The US president says the two sides are finalising documents to avert import taxes targeting a range of Canadian goods.

world_news_real.title: Christian metal band Demon Hunter sue Netflix over KPop Demon Hunters
world_news_real.description: The band say they face "an existential crisis" after the success of the K-pop-inspired Netflix film.

world_news_real.title: South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request
world_news_real.description: It comes after Trump announced plans to curtail joint military exercises with South Korea, citing a "very good" relationship with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.

world_news_real.title: Apparent human remains found in US reservoir as water levels hit record low
world_news_real.description: The skeletal remains in Lake Mead include what appears to be a human jaw with teeth attached, a witness says.

world_news_real.title: Liberia agrees to accept 1,200 foreign deportees from the US
world_news_real.description: Liberia says the deal is a "humanitarian arrangement" and is receiving no compensation.

world_news_real.title: Meta hooked children on Facebook and Instagram, US court hears
world_news_real.description: Meta argued social media addiction does not exist, as a trial stemming from a major lawsuit brought by US states started.

world_news_real.title: US condemns 'unnecessary escalation' after Israeli airstrikes on Syrian airbase
world_news_real.description: Damascus called the attacks "an unjustified act of aggression" that imperilled regional security.

world_news_real.title: 'I don't want to send you to prison', witness tells Tupac accused in combative testimony
world_news_real.description: A member of Tupac Shakur's entourage said he was threatened with contempt of court if he did not testify in the murder trial of Duane "Keffe D" Davis.
